title: Krymske
summary: Krymske refers to several locations within Ukraine, each with distinct administrative affiliations. These places are significant in their respective regions, contributing to the cultural and geographical diversity of Ukraine.

sections.heading: Krymske in Crimea
paragraphs: Krymske is a village located in the Saky Raion of [[crimean-khanate|Crimea]]. As part of this historically rich region, it reflects the unique cultural heritage of Crimea within [[ukraine|Ukraine]].

sections.heading: Krymske in Donetsk Oblast
paragraphs: In [[donetsk-oblast|Donetsk Oblast]], Krymske is identified as a settlement situated in [[bakhmut|Bakhmut]] Raion. This area has been significant in the context of regional development and the ongoing conflict in Eastern Ukraine.

sections.heading: Krymske in Luhansk Oblast
paragraphs: Krymske also refers to a village in the Shchastia Raion of [[luhansk-oblast|Luhansk Oblast]]. This village is part of a region that has been affected by geopolitical tensions and conflict, highlighting the challenges faced by local communities [[coal-in-ukraine|in Ukraine]].
